title: Guider agent never releases AGENT_GUIDER_RESET_MKGP_PROPERTY
summary: agent_device_attach() creates AGENT_GUIDER_RESET_MKGP_PROPERTY (indigo_drivers/agent_guider/indigo_agent_guider.c:2782) and agent_device_detach() releases its neighbour AGENT_GUIDER_RESET_PPEC_PROPERTY but not this one; 3656 bytes lost per agent attach/detach. Next: add the release.
evidence: indigo_drivers/agent_guider/indigo_agent_guider.c:2782, release list near line 3287; valgrind, task verification.md

resolution.evidence: Task 20261025152706-abbf-fix-server-leaks verification.md V1: the leak check reports 0 bytes definitely lost after the fix.
